name: Sika FerroGard-500 Crete
paste:
SIKA® FERROGARD®-500 CRETE: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® FerroGard®-500 Crete, April 2023, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/a/sika-ferrogard-500crete.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® FerroGard®-500 Crete where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description.
    - The Sika® FerroGard®-500 Crete is a 1-part, pre-mixed mortar packaged in a sealant cartridge.
    - The Sika® FerroGard®-500 Crete mortar is used in the installation of the galvanic Sika® FerroGard® Patch and Sika® FerroGard® Patch CC anode units. The cure time and physical properties have been designed to simplify installation and optimise performance.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sika® FerroGard®-500 Crete may only be used by experienced professionals.
    - Sika® FerroGard®-500 Crete optimises the performances of Sika® FerroGard® Patch and Sika® FerroGard® Patch CC anodes.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.2.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® FerroGard®-500 Crete
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Activating Mortar for Sika® FerroGard® Galvanic Anode Systems
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Specially formulated for application
    - Pre-mixed for ease of use
    - Single component
    - Simple installation
    - Long shelf life
    - Eliminates inconsistency associated with on-site mixing of mortars
    - Minimal site labour requirement reduces costs
    - Absence of site batching minimises waste
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Slaked lime, water, inorganic fillers
    - Appearance and colour: Light grey paste
2.5 System structure. Ancillary products:
    - Sika® FerroGard® Patch and Sika® FerroGard® Patch CC anodes
    - Monitoring equipment
    - Reference Anode Sika® FerroGard® MN 15 RE
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 380 ml cartridge, 20 units per box
    - Shelf life: 12 months from date of production
    - Storage conditions: Product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +30 °C. Always refer to packaging.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Limitations and important considerations. The Sika® FerroGard®-500 Crete must not be applied at temperatures below 5 °C.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. +5 °C min.
5.3 Substrate temperature. +5 °C min.
5.4 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.2):
    - The Sika® FerroGard®-500 Crete must not be applied at temperatures below 5 °C.
5.5 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.6 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® FerroGard®-500 Crete, April 2023, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/a/sika-ferrogard-500crete.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sika Ferrogard 500 Crete, version 25/07/2022, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/q/Sika%20Ferrogard%20500%20Crete.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sika® FerroGard®-500 Crete, version 12/11/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/k/sds-sika-ferrogard-500crete.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Ecology, health and safety - Application.
    - After the necessary anode hole preparation, prepare the end of the mortar cartridge before or after inserting into the sealant gun then fit the nozzle.
    - The Sika® FerroGard®-500 Crete is applied into the prepared holes prior to installation of anodes to ensuring no air entrapment occurs within the mortar matrix. Reference must be made to the appropriate Product Data Sheet and Method Statement for application of anodes into the mortar.
6.4 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.5 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.6 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
